procedure_column: Pang+2016 | JEOL JXA-8100 | WDS Point Analysis (Nanjing U.)

Procedure Name.cell: EPMA-WDS Major Element Silicates/Oxides, NWA 8003 Eucrite (Nanjing U., JEOL JXA-8100)
Procedure Name.value: EPMA-WDS Major Element Silicates/Oxides, NWA 8003 Eucrite (Nanjing U., JEOL JXA-8100)

Laboratory.cell: State Key Laboratory for Mineral Deposits Research, Nanjing University
Laboratory.value: State Key Laboratory for Mineral Deposits Research, Nanjing University

Procedure Reference(s).cell: Pang et al. 2016, Sci. Rep. 6:26063; doi:10.1038/srep26063
Procedure Reference(s).value: Pang et al. 2016, Sci. Rep. 6:26063; doi:10.1038/srep26063

Target Material.cell: plagioclase and its polymorphs — 'Measurements of most minerals were performed with a focused beam ... whereas measurements of plagioclase and its polymorphs were performed with a defocused beam'; the other minerals are not listed (EPMA data in Supplementary Table 4)

Sample Preparation Method.cell: Polished thin section; carbon coating N
Sample Preparation Method.value: Polished thin section; carbon coating N

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Phase > Analysis point — compositions are reported as per-phase means, "The average compositions (Supplementary Table 1) of orthopyroxene" (p.2) and "41 ± 8 mol% on average; based on 13 analyses" (p.4); the individual points are in a supplement not in the archived PDF

Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.cell: Spatial position within the shock assemblage — garnet is analysed "within the eclogitic mineral assemblage of zoned veins" and contrasted with grains "in either thin melt veins or the edge zones of zoned melt veins" (p.4); the individual grains are not otherwise chosen by a stated rule
Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.value: Spatial position within the shock assemblage

Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.cell: SEM petrography — "The petrographic texture of NWA 8003 was observed using a JEOL 7000F field emission gun scanning electron microscope (FEG-SEM) at Hokkaido University" (p.7); phase identifications also rest on Raman spectra and EBSD patterns (p.4)

Analytical Mode.cell: WDS Point Analysis — 'Electron Probe Micro-Analyzer (EPMA) with wavelength dispersive spectrometers (WDS)'

Beam Mode.cell: plagioclase and its polymorphs: Defocused; other: Focused — Methods

Beam Current.cell: all: 20 nA — 'a focused beam of 20nA ... at the same beam current'

Beam Diameter.cell: plagioclase and its polymorphs: 2–5 µm; other: N — 'a defocused beam (2–5 μm in diameter)'

Target Species.cell: N — no element is named in the paper; the analysed elements are in Supplementary Table 4, which is not in the archived PDF

Monitored Elements.key: defines: monitored property per target species
Monitored Elements.cell: N — "Natural and synthetic standards were used" (p.7) without naming them; the analysed elements are given in Supplementary Table 4, which is not in the archived PDF

Reported Variables and Units.cell: En, Fs, Wo; Ca-Eskola component; empirical formulae — mol% (p.2, p.4); the oxide analyses are in Supplementary Tables 1–4, not in the archived PDF

X-ray Detection Method per Monitored Ele.cell: all: WDS — 'JEOL8100 ... with wavelength dispersive spectrometers (WDS)'

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: Partially — the reported averages state their contributing counts ("based on 12 analyses" for orthopyroxene, and "14 analyses" for augite, p.2; "based on 13 analyses" and "34 ± 7 mol% on average; 19 analyses" for the Ca-Eskola component, p.4). No acceptance or rejection rule is stated

Combination Method.cell: En, Fs, Wo: average per pyroxene phase; Ca-Eskola component: average per clinopyroxene setting; other: N — 'The average compositions ... of orthopyroxene ... based on 12 analyses'; 'Ca-Esk components (41 ± 8 mol% on average; based on 13 analyses)'

Primary Calibration Standard Name.cell: N — 'Natural and synthetic standards were used'

Detection Limit.cell: all: better than 0.02 wt% (typical) — 'Typical detection limits for oxides of most elements were better than 0.02 wt%'

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Additional Notes.cell: Pang et al. 2016, Sci. Rep. 6:26063 — NWA 8003 eucrite, Nanjing University. JEOL JXA-8100 (stated as "JEOL 8100"). WDS explicitly stated ("JEOL 8100 WDS"). ZAF matrix correction (NOT "ZAF or PAP" as in v2; paper states ZAF). Focused beam (20 nA) for most phases; defocused 2-5 µm for plagioclase and polymorphs. Natural and synthetic mineral standards (specific names N). Detection limit better than 0.02 wt% (as stated). Analytical software not stated.
